messages.message: ### Step 1: Source-Reference Alignment & Semantic Analysis Task: Align source tokens to the provided Reference Translation; pick in-context sense + grammatical role. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Reference Translation (provided): So bitter is it that death is little more. But in order to treat of the good that there I found, I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST**
- **Line 7** *“Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;”* ⇒ *Locked Meaning*: The speaker asserts a high degree of bitterness ( *amara* ) of the situation, and then states a comparative fact: **Entity A = “death”** is **greater than** **Entity B = “little”** by a **slight degree** (“little more”). Truth‑conditions: *Bitter( situation ) ∧ Greater( death , little ) ∧ Degree( slight )*.
- **Line 8** *“ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,”* ⇒ *Locked Meaning*: The speaker introduces a purpose clause: **Because** the speaker wishes **to treat** ( *trattar* ) **the good** ( *del ben* ) **that** he **found there** ( *ch'i' vi trovai* ). Truth‑conditions: *Purpose( speaker , treat(good) ) ∧ Locate( good , there ) ∧ Find( speaker , good , there )*.
- **Line 9** *“dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.”* ⇒ *Locked Meaning*: The speaker commits to **telling** ( *dirò* ) **about the other things** ( *l'altre cose* ) **that** he **has seen there** ( *ch'i' v'ho scorte* ). Truth‑conditions: *WillSpeak( speaker , about(other‑things) ) ∧ See( speaker , other‑things , there )*.
